description: A lanky, hunched creature with bright green skin crouches low, shown full figure facing the viewer at the party's eye level. It has a long jutting face with red eyes and white fangs, and a wild mane of matted grey hair that spreads out over its shoulders. A ragged dark blue cloak hangs from its back, and a tattered brown hide or bundle is clutched against its belly. Its long arms reach toward the ground with large clawed hands, and its knobby knees are bent wide. It squats on a floor of grey rubble against a pitch-black background. The mood is creepy and feral. Frame 1: the creature hunches low with its head down and grinning; this is held long. Frame 2: it rises a little, eyes glowing, briefly. Frame 3: it stretches up taller with its hair bristling and fangs bared, held a short while. Frame 4: it sinks back halfway, briefly. The loop reads as a slow, menacing swell of the body, like a heavy breath or a rising threat.
title: Hunched green troll in the dark
